free_tier.stated: no free tier is published; the marketplace page serves a static snapshot dated 2026-08-29 of 98 live listings from USD 0.06 per GPU-hour. Snapshot rows per GPU-hour: H100 80 GB PCIe USD 2.63 (Canada), A100-80G PCIe USD 1.42 (Canada and US Central), L40S 48 GB PCIe USD 0.93 (US Central), RTX 4090 24 GB USD 0.42 on an 8x node (US Central) and USD 0.63 on a 1x node (Global, flexible). The snapshot lists no L4. Billing is prepaid from credits and accrues per hour only while the instance exists.

chaining: A resale marketplace: listings are provider-anonymous, so the same H100 or A100 appears at several regions and prices in one board; useful to compare against single-vendor hosted rates.
